summary: Added users storage, task ownership, foreign-key enforcement, indexing, and a safe migration for existing task databases.

messages.content: Database auth schema is ready: users has id, case-insensitive unique username, password_hash BLOB, password_salt BLOB, created_at; tasks now has nullable user_id referencing users(id). Connections enable foreign keys, and unowned legacy tasks remain inaccessible when queries scope by user_id.

decisions: Kept task.user_id nullable for migration compatibility; authenticated task queries must always filter user_id to prevent access to legacy unowned rows.
Used BLOB columns for derived password hashes and salts, a case-insensitive unique username constraint, and an index on tasks.user_id.
